The '''Etti system''' contained [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] and [[Etti V]]. It was located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and was the capital [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
